messages:
morgan: Starting a canary for elysium-70b int8 on canary-pool-7. Seeing memory fragmentation + intermittent OOMs under bursty chat traffic. Any quick tuning ideas?

lee: Which allocator are these nodes using? jemalloc or system? Can you paste the OOM snippet/logs and the model config?

morgan: Paste of the OOM lines from the runtime logs: 
```log
[2026-03-19T15:02:11Z] mem_alloc failed: arena 2: cannot allocate 512MB
[2026-03-19T15:02:11Z] fallback triggered: evict_kv_cache
kv_cache_used=12.3GB kv_cache_limit=16.0GB
new_tokens_inflight=2048 active_sessions=420
stack: runtime::alloc->tensor_alloc->cudaMalloc
```

sam: Two fast levers: lower per-request `max_new_tokens` default and reduce `max_batch_tokens`. Also try disabling aggressive kv prefetch for canary. Fragmentation suggests allocator churn; if nodes use jemalloc we can tweak MALLOC_CONF to reduce dirty pages.

lee: Proposed canary defaults to evaluate (non-breaking):
```yaml
model_defaults:
  max_new_tokens: "768"          # down from 1024 to limit big spikes
  max_batch_tokens: "2048"      # cap batch token footprint
  batch_timeout_ms: "12"        # keep latency reasonable but allow some batching
  kv_cache_eviction_policy: "trim-lite"
  kv_trim_after_steps: "8"
```

morgan: Kicking canary with those values now. Also toggling runtime flag `enable_kv_prefetch=false` and setting MALLOC_CONF on canary nodes to `oversize_threshold:1,lg_dirty_mult:0` for jemalloc.

eval-bot: Quick eval against our instruction-following suite: quality delta ~+0.9 BLEU vs fp16 baseline, small uptick in hallucination tests within noise. p95 latency +4%, token-cost -32% (expected for int8). No obvious regression on top-priority prompts.

sam: If fragmentation persists we can add a scheduled KV compaction between heavy windows: `POST /runtime/compact-kv?model=elysium-70b&mode=light`. Note: compaction adds latency spikes, so run in low traffic windows or stagger nodes.

morgan: Canary 12h summary: OOM rate dropped from ~5% -> 0.3%. Saw ~6 transient 503s correlated with kv_trim events. Rolling batch_timeout to 8ms reduced those 503s without reintroducing OOMs.

lee: OK cool. Next rollout plan: expand to 3 more nodes, shift 20% traffic increments, keep `max_new_tokens:768`. Add an alert: `kv_trim_rate > 0.1` or `oom_rate > 0.5%` => automatic rollback. Also add a perf-regression eval job for the sample prompt suite.

morgan: Filed INF-1352 with canary logs, MALLOC_CONF change, and the new model_defaults. Linking dashboards and the eval run. tagging @oncall for awareness.

sam: :thumbsup:
